verdict.rationale: Speaker attribution is a fair question for a meeting recorder and transcription product like Fathom, so the axis applies. The pack documents transcripts ("Unlimited recordings + transcriptions", a transcript endpoint, transcripts in webhooks). It contains nothing on diarization or on matching transcript lines to named participants rather than generic speaker labels.

support.subject: As a product manager, the transcript attributes words to the right named speakers (diarization plus real name matching), not just "Speaker 1/2"
